what: While hovering an underlined word in the text, every .24s one photo belonging to that word rises from the word’s center, 50px below, offset ±25px sideways and tilted ±5°, and settles in .4s (power4.out), then .5s later shrinks to .9x and disappears over .25s with back.in(3) — keep hovering and the photos form a pile that stacks up and pops out in turn. On touch screens, a tap cycles once through all the photos

options.spread·rise·tilt: Sideways scatter · rise from below (px) · tilt range (deg), default 50·50·10
options.dur·wait·out·shrink: Rise · hold · vanish (seconds) · scale on vanishing, default .4·.5·.25·.9
options.[data-fx-part=photos]: Photo list (children, hidden) — inside [data-fx-part=photo] is cloned and floated up. data-ratio="4/5" as ratio

use: Distance
